taskName: Sweep a library's review queue before a public demo
prompt: The review queue is open in the browser: posts flagged for a look before my saved-posts library goes public in a portfolio demo. Go through every post in the queue and press Remove or Keep on each one. Remove anything sexual or suggestive; anything about politics, elections or politicians; anything hateful or that mocks a group; anything gory or violent for shock; anything that only makes sense to one local community, like local gossip or local celebrities; and anything about my own friends, family or private life. Keep everything else, including things that only look edgy: scenes from films and anime, cosplay, sport, history, and ordinary jokes and memes. Only decide posts in the queue; leave the rest of the library alone.
